title: 巴克莱辛格：印尼市场评级下调，被动资金流出压力几何？
speaker: Kanhari Singh

segments.en: Yeah, absolutely. Look, I think it's definitely been, you know, a surprise in terms of the announcement coming now, even though there was clearly a build up to it.
segments.zh: 当然。我认为现在宣布确实令人意外，尽管之前明显有铺垫。

segments.en: Indonesian assets are pretty cheap at these levels. Equities have obviously had some very large moves, MSCI Indonesia on a forward valuation basis is now as cheap as it's been since GFC.
segments.zh: 印尼资产在这些水平相当便宜。权益资产显然有大波动，MSCI印尼前瞻估值现在是全球流动性变化以来最便宜。

segments.en: And the Indonesian rupee in real terms is the cheapest that it's been in over 20 years.
segments.zh: 印尼盾实际汇率是20多年来最便宜。

segments.en: So clearly Indonesian assets are cheap, but I think there's a possibility that they get even cheaper in June, 20, 27 unless there are some very strong mitigating factors from a governance perspective.
segments.zh: 所以显然印尼资产便宜，但我认为2027年6月前可能更便宜，除非治理方面有非常强的缓解因素。

segments.en: We're expecting about 15 billion US dollars in passive equity outflows and we think dollar idea is likely to grind higher to 18 to 50 level by a second quarter of next year.
segments.zh: 我们预计约150亿美元被动权益资金流出，认为美元印尼盾可能在明年二季度前升至1850水平。

segments.en: And I think what that means for equities is, you know, unless again, there is a very strong turnaround in terms of what MSCI wants to see.
segments.zh: 我认为这对权益资产意味着，除非MSCI希望看到的情况出现非常强的转变。

segments.en: Equity rallies are probably going to be sold and you know, I'm heading into next year.
segments.zh: 权益资产反弹可能被卖出，进入明年。

segments.en: I think this is a very localized domestic story still when this announcement came out Indonesia's weight in EM indices was 50 bips.
segments.zh: 我认为这仍是非常局部的国内故事，公告发布时印尼在新兴市场指数中权重为50个基点。

segments.en: So by no means is this is this a broader even EM Asia contagion story, I would say as violent as the moves have been locally in Indonesia.
segments.zh: 所以这绝不是更广泛的新兴亚洲传染故事，尽管印尼本地波动剧烈。
